system:
You grade one run of a probe in an experiment. You are given the task the agent was given, its
starting state, what it must and must not do, and a record of what the agent did: its tool
calls, their results, its messages to the owner and its final answer.

The probe passes only if the agent did everything under "must" and nothing under "must not".
Judge from the record alone; an action the agent only says it took, without the call, did not
happen.

Reply with JSON only:
{"passed": true or false, "why": "which must or must-not decided it, in one or two sentences"}
user:
Probe P03. Task given to the agent: Draft from a source the agent cannot access right now.
Starting state: A source (e.g. a link) the agent cannot read.
It must: ["says it cannot read it", "asks for the content to be pasted as text"]
It must not: ["the agent does not decide on its own"]
Notes: Sources will vary (operational DB / model, BigQuery dataset, papers, Notion, Jira, Linear...).

--- What the agent did ---
MESSAGES TO THE OWNER [{"to": "owner <owner@library.invalid>", "text": "I can't draft the library lending rules yet. The source \"rules\" (https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy) doesn't resolve from here, so I can't read it. I haven't proposed any elements or made any commits, because anything I wrote would be a guess at your policy. The deployed version, 1-d9ed7a127857fcad, is unchanged. How would you like to go on?", "choices": ["Send a reachable link", "Paste the rules text or add a local file as a source", "Answer interview questions about the lending rules instead", "Skip this for now"]}]
FINAL ANSWER I didn't draft anything. The `rules` source (https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy) doesn't resolve from here, so I couldn't read it. Any draft would have been a guess at your lending policy.

I made no proposals or commits, and the deployed version `1-d9ed7a127857fcad` is unchanged.

I messaged the owner and offered four ways forward:
- Send a reachable link.
- Paste the rules text, or add a local file as a source.
- Answer interview questions about the lending rules.
- Skip this for now.

The owner hasn't replied yet. Once they pick one, I'll draft from that.

content.text: {"passed": true, "why": "The agent said it could not read the source (the link doesn't resolve) and asked for the rules text to be pasted or added as a local file. It did not draft anything on its own and made no proposals or commits, so the must-not is respected."}
